Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the following posts with the prescribed proforma (available on website:
www.mgims.ac.in
). The application along with all certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates should reach to the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Dist.
